tree.text: There are hereby authorized to be appropriated such sums as may from time to time be necessary to carry out this chapter, including sums—

children.text: to cover administrative expenses authorized under section 4126 of this title;
to reimburse the National Flood Insurance Fund established under section 4017 of this title for—
premium equalization payments under section 4054 of this title which have been made from such fund; and
reinsurance claims paid under the excess loss reinsurance coverage provided under section 4055 of this title; and
to make such other payments as may be necessary to carry out the purposes of this chapter.

tree.text: All such funds shall be available without fiscal year limitation.
There are authorized to be appropriated such sums as may be necessary through the date specified in section 4026 of this title, for studies under this chapter.

notes.text: References in TextThis chapter, referred to in subsecs. (a) and (c), was in the original a reference to “this title” meaning title XIII of Pub. L. 90–448, Aug. 1, 1968, 82 Stat. 572, known as the National Flood Insurance Act of 1968, which is classified principally to this chapter. For complete classification of this Act to the Code, see Short Title note set out under section 4001 of this title and Tables.
